statement: When enabled, the predictor shall use a 64-entry direct-mapped BTB with a 2-bit BHT, complete PC tag, target, valid bit, and JAL type bit.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Default BRANCH_PREDICTOR_INDEX_W=6 elaborates 64 table entries and a 24-bit PC tag.
The lookup requires valid and complete-tag equality.

source: approved detailed plan sections V and XII

statement: The predictor shall predict only conditional branches and JAL; JALR, RET, indirect calls, CSR/trap/xRET, and interrupts shall retain the existing execution redirect path.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A correctly predicted conditional branch or JAL does not redirect or flush.
JALR/RET behavior is unchanged and never trains the first-version predictor.

source: approved detailed plan sections V and IX

statement: With SUPPORT_BRANCH_PREDICTION=0, the scalar CPU shall preserve baseline instruction behavior, retired instructions, CRC, and timed cycles.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Predictor-off CoreMark has identical text, retired instructions, cycles, CPI, and component CRC to the isolated baseline run.
The predictor table is absent from the disabled Vivado design.

source: approved detailed plan sections III, IV, XI, and XII

statement: Prediction metadata shall remain aligned with the accepted instruction request through response buffering, decode staging, stalls, and redirects.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The prediction bit is captured with pc_d_q on request acceptance and with the instruction in the skid/extra-decode buffers.
No wrong-path instruction retires or creates a side effect after a misprediction.

statement: The predictor shall target distributed RAM/LUTRAM, add no BRAM or DSP, and keep the stated LUT/FF and Fmax goals subject to post-route measurement.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Vivado reports the predictor arrays as LUTRAM or distributed RAM, with zero BRAM/DSP increment.
Post-route Fmax, LUT, and FF deltas are reported for A0/A1/D0/D1.

source: approved detailed plan sections VII, XI, and XII

statement: The isolated experiment shall provide reproducible unit, integration, CoreMark, and Vivado evidence without changing CoreMark source, compiler options, LSU, forwarding, scoreboard policy, or pipeline count.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All executed checks include command, tool version, configuration, result, and artifact path.
Unexecuted checks and residual risks are explicitly reported.

source: approved execution prompt sections II, X, XI, and XIV
